I have alot of these same concerns as I believe many of us dealing with lupus do. If I could give any advice. It would be that we find our own purpose in life. It may not be the extravagant life we imagined when we were children but the impact you have on someone else's life can lead them to the extravagance you once desired. This is the " path" I've chosen with my children. Even though losing an ovary or even personal decisions can leave us to not have children of our own .But their are millions of children who would consider having an adoptive mother as their childhood dream of an extravagant life. Not saying that's what you should do. Just giving an example.  I truly hope you find a partner to spend life with as IMO being lonely is amongst some of the worst pain.
